dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Dolphins (1-9) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Jets
bullets: Roster & Front Office: Miami signed P Jack Browning from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DE Max Llewellyn to the practice squad [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/nfl-practice-squad-updates-11-25-26).

Injury & Practice Status: Miami opened LB Ronnie Harrison Jr.'s 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for S Dante Trader Jr. (shoulder / groin), DE Rodney McGraw (shoulder), and OT Austin Jackson (elbow / knee). P Bradley Pinion (right groin), WR Jared Wayne (quad), and CB JuJu Brents (neck) did not practice Wednesday, while LB Jacob Rodriguez (knee) and S Jaylin Simpson (kneee) practiced in full [David Furones](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4360488/juju-brents#:~:text=Brents%20%28neck%29%20did%20not%20participate%20in%20Wednesday's).

Week 12 Jets Outlook: Jeff Hafley and DC Sean Duggan open installation for the New York Jets (3-8, NYJ -4.5, HC Aaron Glenn, OC Frank Reich & DC Brian Duker (Hard Rock Stadium))—a unit ranked #4 in Pass Yards Allowed / Gm (188.3 yds) as Miami prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873089) [miamidolphins.com Official](https://www.miamidolphins.com/news/aqua-archives-home-history-vs-the-jets).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 1-9 (4th in AFC East • #15 Seed in AFC), Miami carries a 0% postseason projection, 0% AFC East division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [James McKinney](https://www.thephinsider.com/miami-dolphins-discussion/125260/miami-dolphins-discussion-week-12-game-vs-ny-jets-predictions-edition).
